sku gsum gyi 'pho ba'i man ngag /btsan thabs su 'pho ba'i man ngag /chags can 'og sgo la brten nas bde ba lam du lhong ba'i man ngag /bsre ba drug pa'i man ngag /rdo rje sems dpa'i gsang lam/ sdig po che btsan thabs su 'tshang rgya ba'i man ngag /mgrin par rmi lam la brten nas sgyu ma btsan thabs su bzung ba'i man ngag /snying gar mi shigs pa'i thig le la brten nas ma rig pa rtsad nas gcod pa'i man ngag |rim lnga cig car ba'i man ngag /gsang ba thugs kyi rim lnga'i man ngag /da lta nyid nas 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi bzhugs tshul gtan la dbab pa/ pha rgyud yang snying*/ ma rgyud yang snying rnams te gdams ngag gi rim pa rnam grangs nyer bzhi yod pas nag khrid du grags pa 'di rnams kyang shin tu gnad 'gag che ba'i gdams pa yin pas rim gyis bstan cing nyams su blang bar bya ba shin tu gal che'o// de ltar yang bla ma 'phags 'od pa yan chad la rim lnga'i gdan rdzogs dmar khrid yig cha khrigs chags med pa la/ bla ma 'phags 'od par grags chen pa bdag rgas pas tshig don ji ltar zin pa dka' zhing*/ zin kyang myur du brjed 'gro bas bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro la gsol ba btab nas/ brjed tho'i yi ge zhig cis kyang mdzad par zhu/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ khong pa 'phags 'od pa rang gi bla mar song bas bka' gnyan zhing gsung ma chog pas mi bya bar yang ma btub/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyi bka' rgya dam po yod pas yi ger gsal bar 'god pa'ang ma btub pas sa bcad tsam zhig mdzad do// phyis bu ston thams cad mkhyen pas lo rgyus de rnams sngon la gsan pas/ bla ma 'phags 'od par rim lnga zhu ba'i dus su/ bdag la bka' rgya mi 'debs par zhu zhes nan cher zhus pas/ bla ma'i gsung gis spyir snyan brgyud yi ger 'bri ba 'di rgyal po dmangs su bab pa grong du rgyu ba dang 'dra| nyes dmigs che zhing gdams ngag mthu dang phan yon chung ba yin/ yig ris de byung ba phan chod lag len gyi dmar khrid bla ma'i man ngag rtsad mi gcod par yi ge de thob nas shes par rlom|

mthar bklag lung du 'gyur bas don la gdams ngag rabs chad du 'jug pa gcig 'dug /cis kyang byed 'dod na bya dgos pa yin mod/ zab khrid bklag lung dang yang zong du ma shor bar gyis/ 'jig rten blos btang nas chos don du gnyer ba las chos la dkon pa ma ston/ gdams ngag don snying dang yan lag tshang bar byin la rabs ma gcod/ nyams su len pa'i bsam pa med pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs gsog pa'i lung thob re tsam byed pa dang*/ 'jig rten rnam gzhag dang bstun pa'i chos zhus lo dang*/ sgom mod ces pa'i lo 'dod pa rnams la thabs lam zab mo'i dgos pa med pas ma sbyin/ lto rgyab ma phyid pa'i yang zong ma byed/ de bas mdong rgyug thogs nas khyi 'gram gcog /sgo gsham rgyug pa mi dga' re shi'o// zhes phyag rgya dang bcas pa mdzad nas gsungs so// de shin tu mad par rtogs nas yi ger 'bri ba'i 'dun pa'ang bshol lo// nyams len drag po ma nus kyang man ngag gi gnad rnams ma brjed tsam yid la byas te 'dug pa la/ chos rje 'jam pa'i dbyangs chen po bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas cis kyang yi ge'i ris su khod cig /ces yang yang bka' bstsal ba'i gsung ma chog par nyams len dngos gzhi rnams brjed tho yi ge'i ris su dge slong rin chen grub kyis bkod pa'o// zhes gsungs pas na/ spyir gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi rim pa smin grol gyi gdams pa rnams| lto rgyab dang*/ yon bdag dang*/ nye du'i ngo srung la gang byung byung du byed/ yi dam gyi nus mthu dang*/ rang nyid kyis rim gnyis gyi na tsam bsgoms pa'i nus pa tshun chad 'dre rdung dang nad pa'i steng du sprug /dbang bskur tsam zhu mkhan byung na sa dang po thob pa'i dga' ba ltar gsang sngags khrom gseb tu 'tshong ba'i rdo rje slob dpon dang sngags pa'i ming bzung ba/ mtshams med lnga spyad pa las kyang brgya 'gyur stong 'gyur gyi tshabs che zhing bdag gzhan bstan pa dang bcas pa dus gcig la phung nus pa'i bla mas sa steng gang ba'i dus 'dir/

rgyud sde kun gyi yang rtse/ zab pa las kyang ches shin tu zab pa/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rdzogs rim 'di lta bu mig dang snying las kyang nges par gces par sems shing*/ de dag kyang 'dus pa'i rtsa bshad kyi rgyud rnams kyi dgongs don rdo rje 'chang nas 'phags pa'i yul du dpal nā ro pa zhes paṇa grub kun gyi rigs kyi bdag po gcig pur gyur pa de nyid kyis/ dpal dgyes mdzad rdo rje mi'i zol la brten pa mar pa chos kyi blo gros zhes rdo rje theg pa'i 'khor lo'i mgon po zla med pa de nyid la bstsal cing*/ rim lnga bsdus pa gsal ba zhes bya ba'i gzhung yang*/ lo paṇa dam pa de nyid kyis puṣpa ha rir bsgyur ba bod du gdan drangs pa/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug mtshur ston dbang gi rdo rje la brgyud pa yid ches khungs btsun gyi spyod yul yin la/ de dag gi khrid dmigs kyang bla ma 'phags pa yan chad la dmar khrid bstar chags sa bcad tsam las nag khrid med la/ de phyin chad nas bshad sgrub kyi ring lugs mtha' dag la rim lnga'i khrid yig ci rigs pa snang yang*| 'ga' zhig ni bshad chos lung rig na yam tsam las dmigs rkang sgo 'dril ba med pa dang*/ 'ga' zhig gis gzhan zer gyi rjes zlos bskyar ba tsam las rang nyams kyi myong ba med pa dang*| la la bshad sgom so so nas rang 'dod dang gang mthun sna tshogs bsdus pas gcig la yid brtan 'gel rgyu med pa'i rigs dang*/ la la ni sngon byon gyi lo paṇa dang dge ba'i bshes gnyen phal cher phyogs snga mar phud nas rang 'dod kyi gze bzong kho na la/ klu sgrub yab sras nā ro mar mtshur kyi dgongs pa 'di yin no zhes rgyus med rgyus gtam byas pa 'ba' zhig mthong ba rnams btang snyoms su gang bder bzhugs su bcug /dmar khrid kyi yig cha bod ma kun las rtsod dus kyi thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston chen po'i khrid yig yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che za ma tog ces pa 'di nyid yid ches kyi gnas su mthong bas gtso bor bzhag

/sems dben gyi skabs lam gyi gdams ngag dang*/ bar do gcig tu byed pa'i bsam gtan gyi skabs su sku gsum gyi 'pho ba dang*/ btsan thabs kyi 'pho ba rnams nag khrid nas bskangs/ gzhan tshig go bde ba dang sna ring thung zur tsam bcos te/ rang gzhan kun 'jug pa bde zhing gsal bar bkod pa ma gtogs rang bzo dang rtog brtags gzhan las rung mthun sogs kyi bsres lhad spu tsam med par khrid yig 'di nyid ni tshad ma'i mchog bslu ba med pa'i gdams pa 'khrul ba med pa'i mig mkhan rdo rje 'chang chen po thob 'dod kyi las can rnams kyi snying dang mig ltar btsa' zhing zhe phugs su bcang ba'i nor gyi mchog tu thag chod par bzung la nyams su longs/ gdams ngag thob blo dang dpe char lus na mtshan nyid pa'i dge bshes dang khyad ci yod/ nam zhig paṇḍi ta'i mal sar tha mal pa'i ro 'byung bar 'dug pa mang ba la bsam zhing ltos la man ngag rang rgyud la khol cig /yang thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston gyis nyams khrid ma tshar ba la dpe 'di mi ston pa'i bka' rgya yod do// bklag lung byed na rdo rje 'chang gis mgo bo khos shig /ces gsung 'dug pa'ang dus phyi ma'i bla ma dang slob ma kun gyis thugs ma brjed par phyag tu len par mdzad pa rigs so// smras pa/ zab don 'dus pa'i rdzogs rim gdams pa'i dpyid// gegs med thob cing don la ma 'khrul ba// ji ltar rtogs 'di 'jam mgon dpa' bo de'i// thugs rjer nges pas slar yang bdag 'dud do// dpal ldan 'dus pa'i rtsa bshad rgyud don dpag par dka' ba'i chu gter cher// klu sgrub klu yi dbang po gang des dgos 'dod kun sbyin bai ḍūrya// rab bsngags de ko nā ro mar pa ded dpon mkhas pas rab bsrubs pa// snying po'i nor bu phreng bar spel 'di chos kyi grags pa'i blo nor yin// de ltar zab don nor bu'i phreng*// go bde'i srad bu la bstar ba// thar 'dod blo ldan kun la ngas// de ring byin gyis dga' bas longs// 'di phyi kun tu bde ba'i thabs// rgyal ba'i gsung ltar mi 'bad pa'i// sdug bsngal rgyu spyad bde thob par// 'dod rnams 'khrul rmongs 'di ci ga

/'dir 'bad dge ba ston zla ltar// rab dkar nyams pa med pa gang*// ma gyur 'gro rnams rdzogs byang chub// thob phyir bsngo ba gegs med shog /bdag kyang deng nas tshe rabs kun// lam bzang 'di dang mi 'bral zhing*// nyams su bstar bas rigs drug pa// rdo rje 'dzin pa de thob shog /dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rdzogs rim/ rim lnga gdan rdzogs kyi dmar khrid zab don nor bu'i phreng ba zhes bya ba 'di'ang*/ rang nyid nyams su blang ba dang*/ sems can skal pa dang ldan pa rnams rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang tshe gcig la thob par 'dod pa'i bsam pa dkar po rtse gcig tu nye bar bzhag ste/ 'phyongs rgyas dpal ri ba dge slong grags pa dbang pos bskul ba'i ngor bgyis te/ 'bri gung pa shākya'i dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa chos kyi grags pas/ me khams nor skyong gi lo dbyar 'bring chu shel gyi dbang po snron gyi dga' ma dang lhan cig brtse zhing*/ nam mkha'i nor bu karkaṭa'i lam du 'phyo ba'i dmar po'i rgyal ba gnyis pa la/ 'bri dam pa chos phyug gi klung pho brang sra brtan rdo rje'i gnas mchog rtse ba gzhis kar sbyar bas sems can kun la sman par gyur cig/ //siddhi rastu/ sarba maṅga laṃ//
